subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

To catch someone’s fancy
solution: The correct answer is option 3), i.e., "To appeal to someone." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let’s look at the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase: • The phrase 'To catch someone’s fancy' means 'To be appealing or pleasant to someone; to be intriguing or of interest to someone.' (किसी के लिए आकर्षक या सुखद होना; किसी के लिए पेचीदा या रुचिकर होना) • *Example*: • *​Shyam will buy any bike that **takes his fancy.*** • Hence, the only possible answer is option 3, 'To appeal to someone,' which exactly resembles the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase. Correct meaning:__ *To appeal to someone.* 214:T2517,
